safety.text: A legitimate gHYBR holder performing a full exit via GovernanceHYBR.withdraw should be able to withdraw their locked HYBR rather than have the call revert.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The revert propagates and the withdrawal fails, leaving the user unable to exit their position.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The full-exit withdrawal is a legitimate operation by a gHYBR holder, not an unauthorized action.
The revert is the direct observable failure of the withdrawal call, not a downstream economic consequence.

limitations: The specific zero-valued split leg (remainingAmount vs feeAmount) is not formalized; only the reported revert outcome is bound.
No numeric magnitudes are reported for the split amounts, so no numeric relation is encoded.
